start.title: They Return
start.text:
Eleven brothers stand below.
Benjamin is among them. Your heart burns.

choices.text: Order the steward to greet them
Strike them down for old wrongs

strike_consequence.title: Hold Your Hand
strike_consequence.text:
God did not raise you to crush them.
There is a higher purpose.

choices.text: Order the steward to greet them

hide_consequence.title: No Hiding Now
hide_consequence.text:
Father needs his sons home with grain.
You must act with care.

choices.text: Order the steward to greet them

greet.title: Bring Them In
greet.text:
"Bring these men into my house.
Prepare a feast at noon."

choices.text: Have them led to your home

demand_silver_consequence.title: Mercy First
demand_silver_consequence.text:
They are afraid of the returned silver.
Reassure them gently.

choices.text: Have them led to your home

summon_meal.title: At Your Door
summon_meal.text:
They tremble at your threshold.
"It is about the silver," they whisper.

fear_consequence.title: Calm Their Hearts
fear_consequence.text:
Fear closes hearts. You need them open.
Speak peace through the steward.

weep1.title: First Sight of Benjamin
weep1.text:
You see your mother's son.
A flood rises in your chest.

choices.feedback: You hide your tears in your chamber.

choices.text: Embrace him in front of all
choices.feedback: Not yet. The test is not done.

embrace_too_soon_consequence.title: Too Soon
embrace_too_soon_consequence.text:
Their hearts are not yet proven.
Withdraw and weep alone.

choices.feedback: You step away just in time.

recover.title: Wash Your Face
recover.text:
You return composed.
The meal is set, brothers seated by age.

choices.text: Sit with them and break bread
choices.feedback: Benjamin's portion is five times more.

aloof_consequence.title: Honor the Table
aloof_consequence.text:
A shared meal opens hearts.
Sit, and bless their bread.

choices.text: Sit with them and break bread

dine.title: A Strange Wonder
dine.text:
They marvel they sit by birth order.
Benjamin's plate is heaped highest.

choices.feedback: You must know their hearts toward Benjamin.
First test their love for Benjamin.

send_home_consequence.title: One Test Remains
send_home_consequence.text:
Will they abandon Benjamin as they
abandoned you? You must know.

choices.feedback: You call the steward in secret.

cup_plan.title: The Silver Cup
cup_plan.text:
"Hide my cup in Benjamin's sack.
Return their silver too."

choices.text: Place the cup in his sack

cancel_consequence.title: See It Through
cancel_consequence.text:
Without this test you will never know.
God has prepared the moment.

choices.text: Place the cup in his sack

wrong_sack_consequence.title: Benjamin Alone
wrong_sack_consequence.text:
Only Benjamin's danger reveals
whether they have changed.

choices.text: Place the cup in Benjamin's sack

send_off2.title: Dawn Departure
send_off2.text:
Donkeys laden, they ride out at dawn,
light in their step.

choices.text: Send the steward to overtake them
Let them ride home in peace

let_go_consequence.title: Finish the Test
let_go_consequence.text:
If they leave now, you learn nothing.
Send the steward at once.

choices.text: Send the steward to overtake them
choices.feedback: He rides hard and catches them.

overtake.title: Halted on the Road
overtake.text:
"Why have you repaid good with evil?
Where is my master's silver cup?"

accuse_one_consequence.title: Search All Fairly
accuse_one_consequence.text:
An unjust accusation breaks the test.
Let the cup speak for itself.

search_sacks.title: Eldest to Youngest
search_sacks.text:
Sack after sack — clean, clean, clean.
Benjamin's is opened last.

choices.feedback: The cup gleams in the grain.

stop_consequence.title: Let It Surface
stop_consequence.text:
Stopping now buries the truth.
God is at work in this moment.

found_in_benjamin.title: The Cup Found
found_in_benjamin.text:
Silver glints in Benjamin's sack.
The brothers tear their robes.

choices.text: Bring all eleven back to you

choices.feedback: Will they all stand for him?

take_one_consequence.title: Bring Them All
take_one_consequence.text:
You must see if they stand by Benjamin.
Let them all return.

choices.text: Bring all eleven back to you

return_to_palace.title: Back Before You
return_to_palace.text:
Eleven men fall to the ground.
Dust on their faces, hearts broken.

no_test_consequence.title: Wait for Judah
no_test_consequence.text:
Their words now will reveal everything.
Let them speak.

fall_down.title: On Their Knees
fall_down.text:
"God has uncovered our guilt," they cry.
"We are all your servants."

all_prison_consequence.title: Only Benjamin
all_prison_consequence.text:
The test must isolate Benjamin alone.
Will the others abandon him?

death_consequence.title: Never
death_consequence.text:
Benjamin is your blood. The test is
for the brothers, not for him.

judah_steps.title: Judah Steps Forward
judah_steps.text:
Judah lifts his head from the dust.
"My lord, hear your servant speak."

silence_consequence.title: Hear Him
silence_consequence.text:
Judah's words are the test's true answer.
Let him speak.

plea.title: "Take Me Instead"
plea.text:
"My father's life is bound to the boy.
Let me stay. Let Benjamin go home."

choices.text: Send all attendants out at once
choices.feedback: You can hold back no longer.
His pledge is the test's answer.
The time has come to reveal.

mock_consequence.title: He Has Changed
mock_consequence.text:
Judah, who once sold you, now offers
himself for his brother. Reveal yourself.

choices.text: Send all attendants out at once

accept_consequence.title: No More Hiding
accept_consequence.text:
The test is finished. Their hearts
are proven. It is time.

choices.text: Send all attendants out at once

send_attendants_out.title: "Go Out from Me!"
send_attendants_out.text:
The hall empties of Egyptians.
Only eleven brothers remain.

frighten_consequence.title: Enough
frighten_consequence.text:
The waiting is finished. Speak.
Let love break the silence.

reveal.title: "I Am Joseph"
reveal.text:
"I am Joseph your brother.
Is my father still alive?"

choices.feedback: Not one of them can answer.

roar_consequence.title: Gentleness
roar_consequence.text:
They are terrified. This is not
the moment for triumph.

brothers_silent.title: Stunned to Silence
brothers_silent.text:
They cannot speak. They cannot move.
Terror and shame fill their eyes.

choices.text: "Come near to me, I beg you."

demand_confess_consequence.title: Comfort First
demand_confess_consequence.text:
Forgiveness is given before it is asked.
Draw them close.

choices.text: "Come near to me, I beg you."

comfort.title: "Do Not Be Grieved"
comfort.text:
"I am Joseph, whom you sold.
Do not be angry with yourselves."

choices.text: "You will pay for what you did"
choices.feedback: God has turned it to good.

condemn_consequence.title: God's Hand
condemn_consequence.text:
It was God's plan, not their cruelty,
that brought you here. Tell them.

it_was_god.title: To Save Many Lives
it_was_god.text:
"To preserve a remnant for you,
to save many lives — God did this."

choices.feedback: You fall on his neck weeping.

shame_consequence.title: Embrace
shame_consequence.text:
Forgiveness without embrace is empty.
Go to Benjamin first.

kiss_benjamin.title: Brother on Brother
kiss_benjamin.text:
Benjamin weeps on your neck.
Then you kiss every brother and weep.

choices.text: Tell them to bring Father here

hide_jacob_consequence.title: Tell Father
hide_jacob_consequence.text:
Jacob has mourned you for years.
Do not steal one more day from him.

choices.text: Tell them to bring Father here
choices.feedback: You give them wagons and gifts.

send_for_jacob.title: Wagons for the Journey
send_for_jacob.text:
Pharaoh hears and rejoices.
"Give them the best of all Egypt."

guards_consequence.title: Trust Restored
guards_consequence.text:
Mistrust now wounds the new bond.
Let them go in peace.

jacob_hears.title: In Canaan
jacob_hears.text:
"Joseph is alive — and ruler of Egypt!"
Jacob's heart faints — then revives.

choices.feedback: "I will go and see him before I die."

abandon_consequence.title: Together Again
abandon_consequence.text:
Father must see his son.
Take him with you to Egypt.

journey_egypt.title: Toward Goshen
journey_egypt.text:
Wagons cross the desert.
Father is coming. The family is whole.

choices.text: Ride out to meet him in Goshen
choices.feedback: You fall on his neck a long time.

servants_consequence.title: Go Yourself
servants_consequence.text:
After all these years — go to him
with your own arms open.

choices.text: Ride out to meet him in Goshen

ending.title: Father and Son
ending.text:
Jacob holds you. "Now I can die,
for I have seen your face again."
